gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-general-sans: Graceful and loose, LXGW WenKai TC writes its round characters like a relaxed hand with a pen. General Sans follows in a plain sans, its tall lowercase filling each line with smooth, steady strokes.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-bhutuka-expande: Casual yet graceful, LXGW WenKai TC feels penned by hand, never pressing harder or turning its angle. BhuTuka Expanded One brings literary, authoritative weight, its curvy classic serif letters slowing a long page to a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-hepta-slab: LXGW WenKai TC leads with loose, handwritten curves that look jotted down in a hurry. Hepta Slab then stretches each word out, its slab strokes uniform and its counters open, so a long page would feel dignified and unhurried.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-kiwi-maru: Soft, hand-inked and a touch playful, LXGW WenKai TC sets its open curves beside a serif with generous letterspace. Kiwi Maru supplies the editorial, traditional footing.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-orbit: LXGW WenKai TC writes like an easy, unhurried hand. Orbit counters with a plain sans whose curves stop short of closing and whose characters float apart, every stem and bowl holding the same rope-like consistency.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-padyakke-expand: Padyakke Expanded One reads wide and literary, each glyph spread out like knots on a slack rope. LXGW WenKai TC does its best work with relaxed pen-drawn curves, while the text serif holds the authority.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-science-gothic: A pen that never shifts pressure or angle drives LXGW WenKai TC. Its handwritten warmth is the draw up top, while Science Gothic, a sans-serif with stroke ends set far apart, lets each letter be read one at a time.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-stint-ultra-exp: Loose pen strokes meet wide, floating type here. LXGW WenKai TC keeps its casual curves, and Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif with open counters, can take a modest size so its spread-out letters stay comfortable.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-syncopate: Handwritten charm, graceful and a little offhand. LXGW WenKai TC is paired with Syncopate, a sans drawn with technical-pen steadiness, which wants a modest size so its rope-ladder spacing doesn't sprawl.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-manrope: Manrope arrives bright and approachable. Its sans letters keep a minimal step from capitals to lowercase and a pen line of one width, so a long page would read smoothly beneath the handwritten curves of LXGW WenKai TC.
